faq.q: What is the origin of Khairunisa?
faq.a: Khairunisa is associated with Arabic. Khairunisa is Arabic خَيْرُ النِّسَاء (Khayr al-Nisāʾ) 'best of women', a compound name. The source gloss 'Prosperous Woman' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khairunisa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khairunisa, khairunisa. Script forms are خير النساء, خیرونسا, ख़ैरुन्निसा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
